V2 更新说明

大家好 👋
这个工作流已经更新到V2。

✨ 更新内容

  • 🔧 流程优化
    基于对 F2K 生成机制更深入的理解，对流程进行了改进。

  • 🧠 优化二次处理逻辑
    第二次处理现在只用于增强第一次生成的结果。由于 F2K 是编辑模型，像 V1 那样进行两次完整生成并不合理，这一点已经修正。

  • 🎯 更好支持
    提升了对两个版本的兼容性和表现。

  • ⚡ 体验优化（QoL）
    提升整体使用体验，让流程更加顺畅。

🚀 V2 Release Notes

Hi everyone 👋
I’ve updated this workflow toV2.

✨ What’s New

  • 🔧 Process improvements
    Refined the workflow based on a better understanding of F2K generation behavior.

  • 🧠 Improved 2nd pass logic
    The second pass now only enhances the first image. Since F2K is an edit model, running two full passes (as in V1) was not ideal — this has now been corrected.

  • 🎯 Better support forMoody Desire V2 (LITE + PRO)
    Adjusted for improved compatibility and performance with both versions.

  • ⚡ Quality-of-life improvements
    General usability improvements for a smoother workflow experience.
